pages.text: On Sunday morning, Mila's family makes pancakes together. That is one family tradition.
At night, Grandma sings the same gentle song before bed.
Every Friday, the family calls cousins who live far away.
On special holidays, they decorate the table with colors and flowers.
Mila's friend has a different tradition: soup night every Wednesday.
Another friend plants a tree on each birthday.
Mila learns traditions can be big events or tiny daily habits.
Her class starts a kindness jar and adds notes when someone helps others.
Soon the jar is full of little kind moments and proud smiles.
Mila writes: traditions help families remember, connect, and care.
